svg.title: F32-5 IST scenario sheet as printed: IST-B2-DH3-S01 Rev C, utility loss at 100 % load
svg.text: Scenario lines (role leads record, test director signs)
Observed values come from loggers, PQ analyser files and SOE records with time stamps, never from memory.
A line result is pass, fail or not observed. A failed scenario is closed only by a retest record on the same script with the same acceptance values.
Battery energy used: 1.5 MW × 12.4 s / 3,600 = 5.2 kWh, about 2 % of the 301 kWh battery screen value.
F32-5 IST scenario sheet as printed: IST-B2-DH3-S01 Rev C, utility loss at 100 % load
Hall B2-DH3 · 12.0 MW IT (9.6 liquid, 2.4 air) · T0 = relay test trip of both 20 kV incomers · generator bus closed 12.4 s · retransfer parallel 84 ms
• No rack PDU lost power (0 of 200) and the generator bus closed in 12.4 s against 15 s.
• One unexpected priority 1 alarm (CH-02 low oil pressure) makes the scenario a conditional pass with issue IST-DH3-014.
